g.text: 1. Identical net labels are electrically connected. All GND symbols share one net.
2. D1 isolates XIAO USB VBUS from VSYS. Do not reverse A / K orientation.
3. U3 LED is a control input to its onboard MOSFET; no external driver is added.
4. All signals are 3.3 V logic. Pin numbers are given only for the TFT header.
5. NC crosses mark unused touch / compass signals. Other unused pads omitted.
6. Main power-switch location and D1 part/rating are unspecified; not invented.
LOAD may fall below the GPS manufacturer's 3.6 V minimum on battery power.
No boost supply or other proposed audit modification has been inserted.
Confirm low-battery operation, diode rating and battery polarity before build release.
Basis: user-confirmed power wiring + OBJECT-CC commit 1a27ed7 (signal wiring).
Module references: Adafruit 6091; Seeed XIAO nRF52840 Sense; LCDWiki MSP3222/23.
Module-level assembly drawing: internal charger, regulator and TFT circuits omitted.
